title: elattostachys falcata
intro: Elattostachys falcata, commonly known as the Chinese angelica tree, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat a range of health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Elattostachys falcata include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-rheumatic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and limonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
